title: A monolithic Co–FeCo8S8 electrode for a stable anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer driven by a fluctuating power supply
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, 17,9435-9442
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04993D, Communication
Jahangir Khan, Heming Liu, Tianhao Zhang, Xin Kang, Zhiyuan Zhang, Yuxiao Dong, Shanlin Li, Jiarong Liu, Qiangmin Yu, Bilu Liu
A monolithic Co–FeCo8S8 electrode shows robust water electrolysis owing to its strong interfacial bonding and barrier-free charge transfer. The electrolyzer showed rapid response and stable operation when coupled with fluctuating solar electricity.
